title: Programme parent state document
description: The parent issue's private document: fence, release plan pointer and the outcome catalogue. The catalogue is data, so a second repository works with no code change.

class.description: What the owner decided: committed, optional, completed or retired. Now and Later are worked out from the task's PR and gate, never stored. CORE, HARDENING and LATER are older names kept only for migration: read as COMMITTED and sorted like any other task, reported as CLASS_LEGACY with a migration patch, and never added by a write.

parent.description: Expected native parent: the programme parent or another outcome. Null means no native parent is expected.

order.description: The priority: the Programme Graph and native sub-issue order sort open outcomes by group (Now, Later, Optional), then order, lowest first, then issue number, so the top Later outcome starts next. Finished outcomes sort by completion time.

name.description: The task name shown in the Task column. Without it, the issue title is shown without a leading code or release.

description.description: One short line saying what the task is supposed to achieve. Shown in the Task Description column.

target.description: Index comment intents name issue, tag, after and parts (SHA-256 page digests with the intent ID removed); directory: true identifies topic directory pages. Both kinds carry decision-trace-index, directories also decision-trace-directory. Pages stay below 60000 characters including headers. Directory lines link decisions directly or older topic indexes on the same issue; directories never link directories. Generated pages are strict, with at most two index hops and 1024 generated indexes. Hand-made indexes without an intent retain one-hop reading: foreign and missing references are ignored and index-to-index references are not followed. Foreign links never cover local comments. At most five topic comments are planned across the pass; larger traces use directory pages directly without speculative topic posts. Partial verified sets settle as NOT_DONE and are adopted before paging the remaining links; mismatched or duplicate pages stay UNKNOWN. Older intents without parts use their part/total metadata.

attention.description: Findings the controller must answer, kept beyond the run that saw them. A complete run adds and resolves only its source's findings; size refusals also record on single-issue passes and resolve only after a complete verified redraw. Only the parent's holder acknowledges or disposes, with a dispose reason kept in private.attention_notes. Not part of the revision digest.

id.description: First 12 hex characters of sha256 of source|code|issue|head.

code.description: From the fixed code table, which gives the next action.

bodySizeDiagnostics.description: Disjoint UTF-16 span lengths matching the redraw limit, with fixed labels and hand-written section numbers only. No page text. The largest five spans plus remainder equal projected_total; required_reduction gets strictly below threshold.

passStoppedDiagnostics.description: Progress counters and fixed labels only; no page or task text. The runtime also enforces total >= done.
